Two Pancake Tortoises at the Buffalo Zoo.
Two Pancake Tortoises at the Buffalo Zoo.
This unusual turtle, with a thin, flexible shell, is native to Kenya and Tanzania, but is now rare due to habitat loss and the pet trade. San Diego Zoo.
